; OSIS: a starting personality for NPCs, by name. Built from the SkyrimNet and CHIM bios of the NPCs of the base game and a few mods (only a name and our own
; label for each: no bio text is in this file). An NPC with a line here starts with that personality, unless a SPID keyword or an OSIS keyword says otherwise;
; any other NPC gets one from their voice set, their AI values or a seeded roll, as before. Once settled, a personality is kept in the save and can still grow with
; experience (Personality page).
;
; name|personality|suffix
;   name: the NPC's name, lowercase, anything but letters and digits as one space.
;   personality: balanced, stoic, vocal, shy, dominant, timid, submissive (the default edition plays it as timid), wild or crazed.
;   suffix: the last three hex digits of the NPC's base form id, to tell two NPCs of one name apart; empty when the name is enough.
;
; Do not edit this file (a new version of the mod replaces it). Put your own lines in npc_personalities_user.txt in this folder, in the same format; they win.
